description: Change a finished virtual tour in place: rename it or its rooms, reorder rooms (the first one is where the tour opens), remove rooms, replace its navigation links, or change how the navigation points look. Free and instant. The tour's public link shows the change right away. Get sceneIds from pedra_get_virtual_tour.

language.description: Language of the tour page and of AI room names. Defaults to "en".

links.description: Replaces ALL navigation links. Each is one direction; add the return link separately.

pitch.description: Vertical angle, -90 to 90 (0 = horizon, the default).

yaw.description: Horizontal angle of the navigation point in the from-scene, -180 to 180 (0 = centre of the photo).

removeScenes.description: sceneIds to take out of the tour (the photos stay in the property). Their links go too.

sceneOrder.description: Every sceneId of the tour in the new order. The first one opens the tour.

showLabels.description: Always show room names next to the navigation points.

name: pedra_update_virtual_tour
title: Edit virtual tour
